sections.heading: Tata Show – Vietnam's One-of-a-Kind Multimedia Live-Action Spectacular

blocks.text: Tata Show is an internationally acclaimed multimedia live-action performance that made its debut in Vietnam's entertainment market. Directed by Viet Tu, it has been presented to audiences at VinWonders Nha Trang since late January 2020. The combination of cutting-edge 3D mapping technology, lighting effects, smoke and fire, and especially performances by more than 100 Vietnamese and international artists creates a grand and visually stunning spectacle.

sections.text:
Tata Show – Vietnam's One-of-a-Kind Multimedia Live-Action Spectacular
Tata Show is an internationally acclaimed multimedia live-action performance that made its debut in Vietnam's entertainment market. Directed by Viet Tu, it has been presented to audiences at VinWonders Nha Trang since late January 2020. The combination of cutting-edge 3D mapping technology, lighting effects, smoke and fire, and especially performances by more than 100 Vietnamese and international artists creates a grand and visually stunning spectacle.

sections.heading: A World-Class Show ‘Made in Vietnam’

blocks.text: Tata Show is the first world-class entertainment production created entirely by a 100% Vietnamese creative team and group of experts, completed in a record time of just three months.
With an investment of USD 10 million and 130 talented Vietnamese and international performers, Tata Show delivers a breathtaking production filled with unprecedented and one-of-a-kind experiences.

Tata Show uses some of the world's most advanced 3D mapping technology, with 14 latest-generation Barco projectors worth millions of dollars and capable of producing extremely powerful laser brightness. The cutting-edge high-resolution projection system creates magical, sparkling imagery in every corner. Sound and lighting systems cover every square meter of the vast square, delivering an immersive and lifelike experience.

sections.heading: DISCOVER TATA'S STORY

blocks.text: Tata Show takes audiences into a thrilling battle between good and evil, stirring new emotions and touching viewers' hearts through the story of Princess Tata, the Ocean Prince, and their friends in the enchanted realm. They must confront the forces of darkness to reclaim the Gem of Happiness and restore peace to the fairy-tale world.

Beloved audiences have called Tata Show the ‘fairy-tale version’ of VinWonders Nha Trang. Get ready to join Princess Tata's adventure through the radiant Land of a Thousand Flowers, inspired by The World Garden and its rare flora from five continents; the shimmering, mysterious Ocean World, symbolizing the discovery of beautiful Nha Trang Bay; and the Realm of Darkness, representing thrilling experiences for courageous hearts.

sections.heading: Executive Director Nguyen Viet Tu

blocks.text: For nearly two decades, director Viet Tu has ranked among Vietnam's leading directors and producers of major entertainment programs. Every stage of his career reflects a forward-looking vision and pioneering position. His works are groundbreaking and creative, blending multiple art forms and cultural perspectives from East to West. His ability to balance artistic sophistication with mass appeal is also a distinctive hallmark of Viet Tu.

sections.heading: Music Director Duong Khac Linh

blocks.text: He is one of Vietnam's leading musicians and record producers, and has served as a coach and judge on music reality television programs such as The X Factor and The Voice Kids Vietnam.

He studied music in the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. After graduating, Duong Khac Linh joined a record company in the Netherlands and also wrote and composed R&B and hip-hop songs for Dutch, French, and American singers.
In 2007, he returned to Vietnam and began developing his career in his homeland, becoming known as one of the most successful musicians of his generation.

chunks.content:
Music Director Duong Khac Linh
He is one of Vietnam's leading musicians and record producers, and has served as a coach and judge on music reality television programs such as The X Factor and The Voice Kids Vietnam.
He studied music in the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. After graduating, Duong Khac Linh joined a record company in the Netherlands and also wrote and composed R&B and hip-hop songs for Dutch, French, and American singers.
In 2007, he returned to Vietnam and began developing his career in his homeland, becoming known as one of the most successful musicians of his generation.

sections.text: 1. What Makes King’s Garden VinWonders Nha Trang Special?

sections.heading: 1.1. Rare Animals at King’s Garden

blocks.text: At King’s Garden Nha Trang, visitors can immerse themselves in a world of rare animals and admire nearly 30 brilliantly colored bird species.
Bird world: Be captivated by nearly 30 bird species from 15 families and many countries around the world, together creating a vivid, colorful panorama.
Meet the giraffes: At the Royal Garden, visitors encounter friendly giraffes that they can feed, gently pet, and photograph for wonderful keepsakes.

blocks.alt: Play, take photos, and feed the giraffes
blocks.title: king's garden Nha Trang

blocks.text: Play, take photos, and feed the giraffes
Flamingos: Feast your eyes on the elegant beauty of magnificent flamingos. This area is also a perfect visual highlight that adds even more charm to the attraction.
Admire the beautiful flamingos
Discover the world of capybaras: With their plump bodies, short golden-brown fur, and excellent swimming ability, the capybaras at King’s Garden are sure to delight you.

Bengal tigers: This tiger subspecies is most commonly found in Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, and southern Tibet, but its population has been declining in recent years. In Vietnam, visitors can see Bengal tigers up close at King’s Garden inside VinWonders Nha Trang.

VinWonders Nha Trang is undoubtedly a must-visit destination on a self-guided trip to Nha Trang. However, few people know that it is home to an especially attractive spot: King’s Garden, a beautiful zoo on Hon Tre Island for visitors of all ages. 1.1. Rare Animals at King’s Garden
At King’s Garden Nha Trang, visitors can immerse themselves in a world of rare animals and admire nearly 30 brilliantly colored bird species.
Bird world: Be captivated by nearly 30 bird species from 15 families and many countries around the world, together creating a vivid, colorful panorama.
Meet the giraffes: At the Royal Garden, visitors encounter friendly giraffes that they can feed, gently pet, and photograph for wonderful keepsakes.
Play, take photos, and feed the giraffes
Flamingos: Feast your eyes on the elegant beauty of magnificent flamingos. This area is also a perfect visual highlight that adds even more charm to the attraction.
Admire the beautiful flamingos
Discover the world of capybaras: With their plump bodies, short golden-brown fur, and excellent swimming ability, the capybaras at King’s Garden are sure to delight you.
Bengal tigers: This tiger subspecies is most commonly found in Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, and southern Tibet, but its population has been declining in recent years. In Vietnam, visitors can see Bengal tigers up close at King’s Garden inside VinWonders Nha Trang.
Rare Bengal tigers at King’s Garden Nha Trang

1.2. Bird Show – A Mesmerizing, Colorful Symphony
Reference schedule: 11:00 AM–11:20 AM and 3:00 PM–3:20 PM
Location: Bird show stage
Bird performance at King’s Garden Nha Trang
At the bird show stage inside King’s Garden, visitors can watch ten performances featuring ten rare bird species. Impressive routines guided by skilled trainers promise a wide range of emotions. After the show, you can approach these talented ‘performers’ and take photos with them.

chunks.content:
4.1. How to Reach Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang
VinWonders Nha Trang Water Park is located on Hon Tre Island. From central Nha Trang Ward, travel to Vinpearl Port and take the over-sea cable car to Hon Tre Island.
Most attractions on Hon Tre Island are close together, so you can walk directly to VinWonders Nha Trang without renting a vehicle. Guests staying at a Vinpearl hotel or resort on Hon Tre Island can take an electric buggy directly to the amusement park.
From the entrance of VinWonders Nha Trang, proceed to the Water World zone to visit the water park. Pass through Fairy Land and turn left to reach Water World.

chunks.section_heading: 4.2. Important Notes for Visiting Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang
chunks.content:
4.2. Important Notes for Visiting Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang
For a thoroughly enjoyable visit to Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang, keep the following information in mind:
Prepare essential items before visiting Vinpearl Nha Trang, such as a hat, sunglasses, bath towel, face towel, swimming goggles, and sunscreen.
What should you wear to Vinpearl Nha Trang? Choose comfortable, breathable clothing so you can enjoy the attractions freely. Swimwear is mandatory when entering the pools and participating in water park activities. If you forget yours, visit an accessory shop inside the park.
To avoid the strongest sunshine, consider visiting the Nha Trang water park between 2:00 PM and 3:00 PM. You will then have about three hours to explore the park.
Some attractions impose minimum height requirements for children. Parents should pay attention to these rules and choose suitable, safe play areas for their children.
VinWonders Nha Trang Water Park is an unmissable destination for cooling off during the summer
Besides the water park, VinWonders Nha Trang has five other zones offering many exciting experiences:
Fairy Land: This zone transports you into a fairy-tale world with captivating thrill rides that are well worth trying.
Festive Hill: Designed for courageous warriors, this zone offers numerous multi-level thrill rides, including Mine Adventure and the Top Spin.
King’s Garden: Known as a miniature animal world amid the sea and sky of Hon Tre Island, this zone is home to some of the world’s rarest animals, including white Bengal tigers, American flamingos, African hippos, ring-tailed lemurs, and nearly 30 colorful bird species.

VinWonders Nha Trang welcomed summer 2024 with a series of new events and entertainment formats, including the blockbuster Flying Theater. On June 1, 2023, VinWonders Nha Trang officially launched Vietnam’s first 360-degree suspended Flying Theater, taking guests across twelve of Europe’s most beautiful landscapes.

sections.heading: 1. What Is a Flying Theater?

blocks.text: A Flying Theater is a distinctive entertainment experience that uses some of the world’s most advanced technology and visual effects to create a highly realistic sensation of flight. Every sense is engaged as synchronized seat movements and on-screen imagery create an immersive illusion of flying.

Special effects and vivid sound are expertly combined to create a realistic flight experience. Seats are arranged in steep vertical tiers, allowing guests’ legs to hang freely and enhancing the unique sensation of soaring through the air.

Viewers can watch the action ahead while feeling movement below and on both sides. For added excitement, Flying Theaters may include wind that blows through your hair, drifting mist, and subtle natural fragrances throughout the space. This seamless combination makes the Flying Theater an exceptionally impressive and appealing experience that everyone should try at least once.

sections.text: 1. Overview of Stunt Show – Vietnam’s First Live-Action Spectacular

sections.heading: 1.1. About the Stunt Show Format

blocks.text: A Stunt Show recreates thrilling action scenes from films in real life, delivering visually stunning and emotionally engaging experiences. The format originated from dangerous sequences performed by professional stunt actors on Hollywood sets. High-speed races, breathless chases, spectacular acrobatics, and large-scale battles are carefully staged to give audiences the most vivid and impressive performances possible.

sections.text:
1.1. About the Stunt Show Format
A Stunt Show recreates thrilling action scenes from films in real life, delivering visually stunning and emotionally engaging experiences. The format originated from dangerous sequences performed by professional stunt actors on Hollywood sets. High-speed races, breathless chases, spectacular acrobatics, and large-scale battles are carefully staged to give audiences the most vivid and impressive performances possible.
Thrilling action sequences at Stunt Shows around the world (Photo: Collected)

sections.heading: 1.2. Vietnam’s First Stunt Show

blocks.text: In addition to world-leading Stunt Shows such as WaterWorld at Universal Studios and The Bourne Stuntacular at Universal Studios Orlando, visitors can now watch a Stunt Show in Vietnam. Its English title is Rise of the Ocean Princess, while its Vietnamese title is Huyen Thoai Bien Xanh.
The Stunt Show takes place at Vinpearl Harbour within the Vinpearl Nha Trang complex on poetic Hon Tre Island. It promises a fresh and distinctive visitor experience as:
Vietnam’s first live-action stunt performance
The first show to use the sea itself as its stage rather than a stage built over the water
Professionally staged and supported by systematic training from international action performers
Produced by directors and screenwriters from Universal’s renowned action-show production team.

Produced by directors and screenwriters from Universal’s renowned action-show production team.

2.1. A World-Leading Production Team
The Stunt Show’s production team—from the executive director and music producers to the action directors—includes renowned, world-leading companies:
Executive direction: Renaissance Entertainment is the world’s largest Stunt Show consultancy. It has developed concepts and provided strategic direction for major internationally award-winning shows at Universal, Disney, and Chimelong, with prominent directors such as Jon Binkowski and Lisa Enos Smith, along with many other leading experts.
Music production: The producers associated with Thomas Bergersen and Nick Phoenix’s ‘Two Steps from Hell’ are responsible for the music of Rise of the Ocean Princess in Nha Trang. The team has also earned multiple Golden Trailer Awards for music used in famous Hollywood films such as Disney’s WALL-E.
Action direction: H2O Events directly oversees the action direction for the Nha Trang Stunt Show. The company specializes in choreographing water-based action for major Stunt Shows and has repeatedly received awards as one of Australia’s leading international sports-event organizers.
Show-technology consulting: Technifex is a world-leading company with extensive experience in concept design, engineering, and the production of performance and entertainment systems. It has helped create internationally award-winning shows and attractions such as Hagrid’s Magical Creatures Motorbike Adventure, The Hebrew Bible Experience, and Volcano Bay at Universal Orlando Resort.

VINPEARL GOLF NHA TRANG
A Unique Golf Experience Beside Vietnam’s Most Beautiful Bay

sections.heading: A MASTERPIECE GOLF COURSE ON A PARADISE ISLAND

blocks.text: Located on an island known for ‘360 days of beautiful sunshine each year,’ Vinpearl Golf Nha Trang features a distinctive mountain-backed, sea-facing landscape, surrounded by green hills and overlooking the vast beauty of a paradise bay. Designed by IMG Worldwide, the course preserves the original natural scenery as much as possible. Its distinctive terrain includes broad, rolling fairways that rise and fall along the hillsides, promising an ideal destination for challenging, enjoyable swings and endless inspiration.

Its distinctive terrain includes broad, rolling fairways that rise and fall along the hillsides, promising an ideal destination for challenging, enjoyable swings and endless inspiration.

Score a Hole-In-One at the Seaside Golf Course

Perfect your swing amid breathtaking mountain-sea landscapes at a golfing paradise.

VINPEARL GOLF NHA TRANG
A Unique Golf Experience Beside Vietnam’s Most Beautiful Bay

A MASTERPIECE GOLF COURSE ON A PARADISE ISLAND
Located on an island known for ‘360 days of beautiful sunshine each year,’ Vinpearl Golf Nha Trang features a distinctive mountain-backed, sea-facing landscape, surrounded by green hills and overlooking the vast beauty of a paradise bay. Designed by IMG Worldwide, the course preserves the original natural scenery as much as possible. Its distinctive terrain includes broad, rolling fairways that rise and fall along the hillsides, promising an ideal destination for challenging, enjoyable swings and endless inspiration.

Designed by IMG Worldwide

General Information

Specifications
Length: 6,787 yards, par 71

Grass Type
- Fairways/Rough/Tee: Seashore Paspalum
- Green: Seashore Paspalum

Tee time
06:00 - 13:30

Facilities

Restaurant
Capacity for 100 guests, serving a diverse selection of Asian and European cuisine and distinctive local specialties prepared by experienced chefs.

Driving Range
10 outdoor practice bays.

Facilities
The pro shop offers a wide range of premium golf apparel and accessories.

Locker
190 men’s lockers, 60 women’s lockers, and shower facilities.

Equipment
A modern night-lighting system across all 18 holes.

card_data.section_title: EXPERIENCE JOURNEYS
card_data.title: Explore Hon Tre in 2 Days and 1 Night – The Call of the Sea Paradise
card_data.description: When in Nha Trang, you must visit Hon Tre! We recommend a 2-day-1-night journey to fully explore this paradise in Nha Trang. Enjoy a luxurious stay at Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang, relax with authentic Korean-style saunas at Aquafield, discover the thrills of VinWonders, and experience the excitement at Vinpearl Harbour!

sections.heading: Day 1: Conquer VinWonders – A Thrilling and Exciting Journey

blocks.text: Morning: Immerse Yourself in a Fairytale & Vibrant Nature
09:30 | You can check in and store your luggage at Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang to comfortably explore this exciting journey.
09:30 | Tata Welcome – Mythical Square: Let the lively melodies and legendary characters at VinWonders ignite your positive energy for an exciting day of exploration!
10:00 | World Garden – A Floral Wonderland in the Ocean: You’ll feel like stepping into a vibrant painting as you admire the stunning flowers in the heart of the island.
10:30 – 12:00 | King’s Garden – The Natural Wonder of Pearl Island: Home to intelligent birds with unique performances, this place also brings you closer to the beauty of wildlife.

sections.heading: 14:00 | Check-in & Unwind

blocks.text: You’ll check into one of the luxurious resorts, where you can indulge in a private, upscale retreat with breathtaking ocean views. 14:00 | Check-in & Unwind
You’ll check into one of the luxurious resorts, where you can indulge in a private, upscale retreat with breathtaking ocean views. Take some time to relax and recharge before diving into the excitement at VinWonders Nha Trang – an entertainment paradise filled with thrilling experiences waiting to be explored!

sections.heading: 15:00 – 16:00 | Nature Exploration at VinWonders Nha Trang

blocks.text: Begin your VinWonders adventure with a fascinating journey into the wonders of nature at King’s Garden, home to a diverse collection of exotic wildlife.

A must-see experience here is the Vibrant Bird Show , featuring dazzling performances by rare and exotic birds. Watch as colorful parrots, majestic falcons, and powerful eagles spread their wings against the sky in a mesmerizing display. Tip: Arrive 30 minutes early to grab the best seats for the show, which starts at 3:00 PM .

Next, embark on an exciting wildlife encounter as you meet the extraordinary residents of the jungle . Marvel at the regal Bengal tigers , observe the playful ring-tailed lemurs , and witness the mysterious presence of mighty rhinos . This journey brings you closer to the wonders of the wild—right in the heart of Nha Trang Bay .

Continue your exploration at Blooming Hill , a botanical paradise where nature flourishes in spectacular ways. Find serenity in the elegant Japanese Garden, immerse yourself in the romantic charm of the European floral gardens, and discover the unique Cactus Collection , showcasing resilient yet strikingly beautiful desert plants.

sections.heading: 17:00 – 18:30 | A Cutting-Edge Entertainment Journey with Advanced Technolog

blocks.text: Step into a magical world with Tata World River Adventure , Vietnam’s first indoor dark water ride . Join Princess Tata and her companions on a colorful quest to find the Gem of Happiness . With stunning light effects, an enchanting storyline, and cutting-edge technology , this immersive experience promises to be truly unforgettable.

Another must-try attraction at VinWonders Nha Trang is the 360-Degree Flying Cinema . Soar through the skies and embark on a breathtaking journey across 12 European wonders —all without leaving your seat. Thanks to state-of-the-art motion simulation , you’ll glide over snow-capped peaks, ancient castles, and spectacular landscapes , feeling every twist and turn as if you were really there!

chunks.section_heading: 15:00 – 16:00 | Nature Exploration at VinWonders Nha Trang
chunks.content:
15:00 – 16:00 | Nature Exploration at VinWonders Nha Trang
Begin your VinWonders adventure with a fascinating journey into the wonders of nature at King’s Garden, home to a diverse collection of exotic wildlife.
A must-see experience here is the Vibrant Bird Show , featuring dazzling performances by rare and exotic birds. Watch as colorful parrots, majestic falcons, and powerful eagles spread their wings against the sky in a mesmerizing display. Tip: Arrive 30 minutes early to grab the best seats for the show, which starts at 3:00 PM .
Next, embark on an exciting wildlife encounter as you meet the extraordinary residents of the jungle . Marvel at the regal Bengal tigers , observe the playful ring-tailed lemurs , and witness the mysterious presence of mighty rhinos . This journey brings you closer to the wonders of the wild—right in the heart of Nha Trang Bay .
Continue your exploration at Blooming Hill , a botanical paradise where nature flourishes in spectacular ways. Find serenity in the elegant Japanese Garden, immerse yourself in the romantic charm of the European floral gardens, and discover the unique Cactus Collection , showcasing resilient yet strikingly beautiful desert plants.
Explore King’s Garden on Hon Tre Island

chunks.section_heading: 17:00 – 18:30 | A Cutting-Edge Entertainment Journey with Advanced Technolog
chunks.content:
17:00 – 18:30 | A Cutting-Edge Entertainment Journey with Advanced Technolog
Step into a magical world with Tata World River Adventure , Vietnam’s first indoor dark water ride . Join Princess Tata and her companions on a colorful quest to find the Gem of Happiness . With stunning light effects, an enchanting storyline, and cutting-edge technology , this immersive experience promises to be truly unforgettable.
Another must-try attraction at VinWonders Nha Trang is the 360-Degree Flying Cinema . Soar through the skies and embark on a breathtaking journey across 12 European wonders —all without leaving your seat. Thanks to state-of-the-art motion simulation , you’ll glide over snow-capped peaks, ancient castles, and spectacular landscapes , feeling every twist and turn as if you were really there!
Immerse Yourself in a Journey Through 12 European Wonders with the 360-Degree Flying Cinema
A perfect fusion of world-class entertainment and cutting-edge technology, where you don’t just watch—you live every magical moment!

sections.heading: Day 2: Endless Fun at VinWonders Nha Trang and Vinpearl Harbour

blocks.text: Morning:

If you’re a sunrise enthusiast who loves fresh morning air, wake up early for a peaceful stroll along the resort’s private beach. You’ll feel the absolute tranquility and rejuvenation, setting the perfect tone for a bright new day full of exciting experiences.
Breakfast Buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant

Indulge in a luxurious breakfast buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant , where the finest Asian and European cuisines come together in a stunning beachfront setting. Savor a rich cup of coffee and a tempting plate of pastries—fueling you for a day full of energy and adventure!
Check in at VinWonders Nha Trang at 9:00 AM and take on exhilarating thrill rides for the ultimate adrenaline rush

Race through sharp turns at 12.7m/s on the Mine Adventure ride, glide around the mountain on Southeast Asia’s largest alpine coaster, or soar through the sky on Vietnam’s record-breaking Zipline, featuring the longest, steepest, and highest landing jump in the country! Note: Zipline does not include in the ticket.
Midday:
Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Princess Tata and her sisters with Tata World River Adventure , Vietnam’s first indoor dark water ride.
Next, experience cutting-edge entertainment at Vietnam’s first 360-degree floating cinema , where you’ll embark on a breathtaking journey through 12 of Europe’s most stunning landscapes .
Don’t forget to recharge with a feast at Wind &Sea Buffet , offering over 50 delectable Asian and European dishes , along with fresh local seafood.
Afternoon:

Visit King’s Garden, the unique island zoo, to meet rare animals such as Bengal tigers, ring-tailed lemurs, and camels. Immerse yourself in the vibrant beauty of hundreds of blooming flowers from around the world at The World Garden.

Stroll through the vibrant dining and shopping world of Vinpearl Harbour and enjoy a traditional Vietnamese family meal at Com Nha Linh, a restaurant that brings you back to the authentic flavors of home through rich and flavorful Vietnamese dishes.

Explore the night market, breathe in the cool evening air by the harbor, and immerse yourself in the dazzling atmosphere of the Drag Queen Show at 20:15 – a mesmerizing performance filled with color and personality.

End the night with the world’s first overwater Stunt Show at 9:15PM at Marina Square. Witness an unparalleled spectacle featuring the magical movements of a giant pearl, an extraordinary story brought to life by talented performers, breathtaking flyboard stunts, and spectacular fire and fireworks displays from above.
Day 3: Relax and Recharge for the Next Adventure

There’s no better way to restore your energy than waking up to the gentle sea breeze and starting your day with a hearty buffet breakfast at Blue Lagoon Restaurant. Next, unwind at Akoya Spa, where you can immerse yourself in a tranquil sanctuary and experience specialized spa treatments such as hot stone massage, herbal steam therapy, or natural essence skincare to rejuvenate your body and mind.

Spend your afternoon conquering Tropical Paradise , Asia’s largest water park at VinWonders Nha Trang. Challenge yourself with thrilling attractions like Neptune’s Fury & Cosmic Disc , Ocean Tornado , Fierce Dragon’s Tail , Whirlpool Tide , Serpent God’s Wrath , Aerial Fleet , and more.
Afterward, test your skills and agility at The Floating Bay , where you’ll engage in an exciting obstacle course on a giant inflatable playground in the open sea.

Don’t miss the chance to immerse yourself in the Wonder Carnival, where you can admire the mesmerizing choreography of hundreds of performers from around the world, bringing the vibrant characters of the Wonderland Kingdom to life.
Evening:

After an exciting day, it’s time for ultimate relaxation at Aquafield Nha Trang, Vietnam’s first premium Korean spa & sauna complex. Experience seven unique therapy rooms, each offering a distinct concept, with temperatures ranging from 5°C to 90°C and humidity levels between 10% and 70%, providing a diverse range of rejuvenating treatments tailored to your needs.
Day 4: Immerse Yourself in the Breathtaking Nature of Vinpearl Nha Trang Before Departure
Start your day with a lavish breakfast buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant .
Take a leisurely stroll along the bougainvillea-lined pathways , capturing your final moments on this island paradise.
Visit the serene and ancient Zen Monastery , a peaceful retreat to reflect and bring a tranquil close to your vibrant adventure.

After days of unforgettable experiences, it’s time to bid farewell to Vinpearl Nha Trang , carrying with you cherished memories. Though the journey ends, the echoes of adventure, relaxation, and pure enjoyment will stay with you forever.

End the night with the world’s first overwater Stunt Show at 9:15PM at Marina Square. Witness an unparalleled spectacle featuring the magical movements of a giant pearl, an extraordinary story brought to life by talented performers, breathtaking flyboard stunts, and spectacular fire and fireworks displays from above.
Day 3: Relax and Recharge for the Next Adventure
There’s no better way to restore your energy than waking up to the gentle sea breeze and starting your day with a hearty buffet breakfast at Blue Lagoon Restaurant. Next, unwind at Akoya Spa, where you can immerse yourself in a tranquil sanctuary and experience specialized spa treatments such as hot stone massage, herbal steam therapy, or natural essence skincare to rejuvenate your body and mind.
Spend your afternoon conquering Tropical Paradise , Asia’s largest water park at VinWonders Nha Trang. Challenge yourself with thrilling attractions like Neptune’s Fury & Cosmic Disc , Ocean Tornado , Fierce Dragon’s Tail , Whirlpool Tide , Serpent God’s Wrath , Aerial Fleet , and more.
Afterward, test your skills and agility at The Floating Bay , where you’ll engage in an exciting obstacle course on a giant inflatable playground in the open sea.
Don’t miss the chance to immerse yourself in the Wonder Carnival, where you can admire the mesmerizing choreography of hundreds of performers from around the world, bringing the vibrant characters of the Wonderland Kingdom to life.
Evening:
After an exciting day, it’s time for ultimate relaxation at Aquafield Nha Trang, Vietnam’s first premium Korean spa & sauna complex. Experience seven unique therapy rooms, each offering a distinct concept, with temperatures ranging from 5°C to 90°C and humidity levels between 10% and 70%, providing a diverse range of rejuvenating treatments tailored to your needs.
Day 4: Immerse Yourself in the Breathtaking Nature of Vinpearl Nha Trang Before Departure
Start your day with a lavish breakfast buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant .
Take a leisurely stroll along the bougainvillea-lined pathways , capturing your final moments on this island paradise.
Visit the serene and ancient Zen Monastery , a peaceful retreat to reflect and bring a tranquil close to your vibrant adventure.
After days of unforgettable experiences, it’s time to bid farewell to Vinpearl Nha Trang , carrying with you cherished memories. Though the journey ends, the echoes of adventure, relaxation, and pure enjoyment will stay with you forever.

chunks.content:
Day 2: Endless Fun at VinWonders Nha Trang and Vinpearl Harbour
Morning:
If you’re a sunrise enthusiast who loves fresh morning air, wake up early for a peaceful stroll along the resort’s private beach. You’ll feel the absolute tranquility and rejuvenation, setting the perfect tone for a bright new day full of exciting experiences.
Breakfast Buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant
Indulge in a luxurious breakfast buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant , where the finest Asian and European cuisines come together in a stunning beachfront setting. Savor a rich cup of coffee and a tempting plate of pastries—fueling you for a day full of energy and adventure!
Check in at VinWonders Nha Trang at 9:00 AM and take on exhilarating thrill rides for the ultimate adrenaline rush
Race through sharp turns at 12.7m/s on the Mine Adventure ride, glide around the mountain on Southeast Asia’s largest alpine coaster, or soar through the sky on Vietnam’s record-breaking Zipline, featuring the longest, steepest, and highest landing jump in the country! Note: Zipline does not include in the ticket.
Midday:
Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Princess Tata and her sisters with Tata World River Adventure , Vietnam’s first indoor dark water ride.
Next, experience cutting-edge entertainment at Vietnam’s first 360-degree floating cinema , where you’ll embark on a breathtaking journey through 12 of Europe’s most stunning landscapes .
Don’t forget to recharge with a feast at Wind &Sea Buffet , offering over 50 delectable Asian and European dishes , along with fresh local seafood.
Afternoon:

sections.heading: Tata Show – Vietnam's One-of-a-Kind Multimedia Live-Action Spectacular

blocks.text: Tata Show is an internationally acclaimed multimedia live-action performance that made its debut in Vietnam's entertainment market. Directed by Viet Tu, it has been presented to audiences at VinWonders Nha Trang since late January 2020. The combination of cutting-edge 3D mapping technology, lighting effects, smoke and fire, and especially performances by more than 100 Vietnamese and international artists creates a grand and visually stunning spectacle.

sections.text:
Tata Show – Vietnam's One-of-a-Kind Multimedia Live-Action Spectacular
Tata Show is an internationally acclaimed multimedia live-action performance that made its debut in Vietnam's entertainment market. Directed by Viet Tu, it has been presented to audiences at VinWonders Nha Trang since late January 2020. The combination of cutting-edge 3D mapping technology, lighting effects, smoke and fire, and especially performances by more than 100 Vietnamese and international artists creates a grand and visually stunning spectacle.

sections.heading: A World-Class Show ‘Made in Vietnam’

blocks.text: Tata Show is the first world-class entertainment production created entirely by a 100% Vietnamese creative team and group of experts, completed in a record time of just three months.
With an investment of USD 10 million and 130 talented Vietnamese and international performers, Tata Show delivers a breathtaking production filled with unprecedented and one-of-a-kind experiences.

Tata Show uses some of the world's most advanced 3D mapping technology, with 14 latest-generation Barco projectors worth millions of dollars and capable of producing extremely powerful laser brightness. The cutting-edge high-resolution projection system creates magical, sparkling imagery in every corner. Sound and lighting systems cover every square meter of the vast square, delivering an immersive and lifelike experience.

Guests explore the radiant Land of a Thousand Flowers, dive beneath the sea into the wondrous Ocean World, and journey to the far reaches of the Realm of Darkness through a spectacular performance.

sections.heading: DISCOVER TATA'S STORY

blocks.text: Tata Show takes audiences into a thrilling battle between good and evil, stirring new emotions and touching viewers' hearts through the story of Princess Tata, the Ocean Prince, and their friends in the enchanted realm. They must confront the forces of darkness to reclaim the Gem of Happiness and restore peace to the fairy-tale world.

Beloved audiences have called Tata Show the ‘fairy-tale version’ of VinWonders Nha Trang. Get ready to join Princess Tata's adventure through the radiant Land of a Thousand Flowers, inspired by The World Garden and its rare flora from five continents; the shimmering, mysterious Ocean World, symbolizing the discovery of beautiful Nha Trang Bay; and the Realm of Darkness, representing thrilling experiences for courageous hearts.

sections.heading: Executive Director Nguyen Viet Tu

blocks.text: For nearly two decades, director Viet Tu has ranked among Vietnam's leading directors and producers of major entertainment programs. Every stage of his career reflects a forward-looking vision and pioneering position. His works are groundbreaking and creative, blending multiple art forms and cultural perspectives from East to West. His ability to balance artistic sophistication with mass appeal is also a distinctive hallmark of Viet Tu.

sections.text:
Executive Director Nguyen Viet Tu
For nearly two decades, director Viet Tu has ranked among Vietnam's leading directors and producers of major entertainment programs. Every stage of his career reflects a forward-looking vision and pioneering position. His works are groundbreaking and creative, blending multiple art forms and cultural perspectives from East to West. His ability to balance artistic sophistication with mass appeal is also a distinctive hallmark of Viet Tu.

sections.heading: Music Director Duong Khac Linh

blocks.text: He is one of Vietnam's leading musicians and record producers, and has served as a coach and judge on music reality television programs such as The X Factor and The Voice Kids Vietnam.

He studied music in the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. After graduating, Duong Khac Linh joined a record company in the Netherlands and also wrote and composed R&B and hip-hop songs for Dutch, French, and American singers.
In 2007, he returned to Vietnam and began developing his career in his homeland, becoming known as one of the most successful musicians of his generation.

sections.heading: Choreographer Sabra Johnson

blocks.text: She was the winner of Season 3 of the world-famous dance and choreography reality television program ‘So You Think You Can Dance.’

She trained extensively across the United States and around the world before joining Cedar Lake Contemporary Ballet in New York City. She later moved to Mexico to collaborate with the Tania Pérez-Salas Dance Company.
In Asia, she began the next stage of her career in Vietnam.

Sound and lighting systems cover every square meter of the vast square, delivering an immersive and lifelike experience.

Executive Director Nguyen Viet Tu
For nearly two decades, director Viet Tu has ranked among Vietnam's leading directors and producers of major entertainment programs. Every stage of his career reflects a forward-looking vision and pioneering position. His works are groundbreaking and creative, blending multiple art forms and cultural perspectives from East to West. His ability to balance artistic sophistication with mass appeal is also a distinctive hallmark of Viet Tu.

Music Director Duong Khac Linh

He studied music in the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. After graduating, Duong Khac Linh joined a record company in the Netherlands and also wrote and composed R&B and hip-hop songs for Dutch, French, and American singers.
In 2007, he returned to Vietnam and began developing his career in his homeland, becoming known as one of the most successful musicians of his generation.

She trained extensively across the United States and around the world before joining Cedar Lake Contemporary Ballet in New York City. She later moved to Mexico to collaborate with the Tania Pérez-Salas Dance Company.

blocks.text: At King’s Garden Nha Trang, visitors can immerse themselves in a world of rare animals and admire nearly 30 brilliantly colored bird species.
Bird world: Be captivated by nearly 30 bird species from 15 families and many countries around the world, together creating a vivid, colorful panorama.

content_blocks.text: Explore King’s Garden – A Zoo on Beautiful Hon Tre Island in Nha Trang

VinWonders Nha Trang is undoubtedly a must-visit destination on a self-guided trip to Nha Trang. However, few people know that it is home to an especially attractive spot: King’s Garden, a beautiful zoo on Hon Tre Island for visitors of all ages. Save these useful tips for exploring King’s Garden in the article below!
1. What Makes King’s Garden VinWonders Nha Trang Special?
1.1. Rare Animals at King’s Garden
At King’s Garden Nha Trang, visitors can immerse themselves in a world of rare animals and admire nearly 30 brilliantly colored bird species.
Bird world: Be captivated by nearly 30 bird species from 15 families and many countries around the world, together creating a vivid, colorful panorama.
Meet the giraffes: At the Royal Garden, visitors encounter friendly giraffes that they can feed, gently pet, and photograph for wonderful keepsakes.

content_blocks.alt: Play, take photos, and feed the giraffes

Flamingos: Feast your eyes on the elegant beauty of magnificent flamingos. This area is also a perfect visual highlight that adds even more charm to the attraction.
Admire the beautiful flamingos
Discover the world of capybaras: With their plump bodies, short golden-brown fur, and excellent swimming ability, the capybaras at King’s Garden are sure to delight you.

Bengal tigers: This tiger subspecies is most commonly found in Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, and southern Tibet, but its population has been declining in recent years. In Vietnam, visitors can see Bengal tigers up close at King’s Garden inside VinWonders Nha Trang.

3. Other Attractive Destinations at VinWonders Nha Trang
Besides King’s Garden, VinWonders Nha Trang has five other highly attractive zones offering countless outstanding experiences that visitors can combine in one trip:
Festive Hill: A zone filled with thrilling rides for adventure lovers who want to push beyond their limits.
The World Garden: Explore the Butterfly Garden, cactus kingdom, Japanese Garden cultural space, hanging botanical garden, and Vietnam’s largest sky wheel—ranked among the world’s top ten.
Wander through a brilliantly colorful floral kingdom at The World Garden
Water World: Home to Vietnam’s first and only freshwater water park on a beach, covering 50,000 square meters and offering endless excitement with 39 water attractions. It also features a floating bay packed with entertaining activities.
Sea World: Explore a diverse marine ecosystem with more than 30,000 rare marine creatures at the aquarium.
Fairy Land: Conquer Southeast Asia’s largest mountain coaster system, stretching 1,865 meters, and ‘fly through the air’ on Vietnam’s steepest zipline with the country’s highest landing jump. Visitors can also enjoy the multimillion-dollar Tata Show at Vinpearl Nha Trang, featuring immersive sound, magical 3D mapping, and modern smoke-and-fire effects.

sections.heading: 1. Remarkable Facts and Figures About Vinpearl Aquarium Nha Trang

blocks.text: As the first large-scale aquarium built in Vietnam, Vinpearl Aquarium Nha Trang covers up to 3,400 square meters and features a highly distinctive arched-tunnel design.

Entering the fascinating ocean world at Sea World, visitors feel as though they are walking through the deep sea while observing nearly 30,000 unusual and rare marine creatures up close. These include seven shark species listed in the Red Data Book, such as reef sharks, leopard sharks, and catsharks.

After a year-long comprehensive renovation, VinWonders Nha Trang Aquarium – Neptune’s Kingdom officially reopened on February 6, 2026, unveiling a vast, vibrant, and awe-inspiring ocean world. A major highlight is the seal pool, making its first appearance in Nha Trang and unique across the entire VinWonders system.

sections.heading: 2.2. A Detailed Aquarium Exploration Journey

blocks.text: Begin your journey at VinWonders Nha Trang Aquarium – Neptune’s Kingdom, where the gateway to the ocean reopened after a comprehensive year-long renovation. Step into a vivid marine world and stop at the unique seal pool, introduced in Nha Trang for the first time, to watch the playful and captivating moments of these ‘ocean performers’ in an impressive naturalistic setting. Continue through the 100-meter underwater tunnel for the sensation of traveling ‘through the sea,’ surrounded by the mesmerizing movement of marine life. The journey concludes in a magical marine kingdom containing more than 15,000 individual creatures—a colorful miniature ocean that inspires discovery. Neptune’s Kingdom is ready to take you on an entirely new ocean adventure.

blocks.text: When visiting Vinpearl Aquarium Nha Trang, please keep the following points in mind:

Book VinWonders Nha Trang admission tickets through the official website to receive the best available price.

Immerse yourself in The Underwater World

Meet 15,000 marine creatures, enjoy the only Mermaid Show in Khanh Hoa, and fall in love with the adorable seal pool that captures every visitor’s heart!

Location: Inside VinWonders Nha Trang amusement park on Hon Tre Island, Nha Trang Bay.
Highlight experiences: Walk through the depths of the ocean, admire nearly 30,000 unusual and rare marine creatures up close, and enjoy impressive shows.
Admission: Fully included in the VinWonders Nha Trang entrance ticket; no separate ticket is required to explore the ocean world.

If you love exploring marine ecosystems and want to discover the ocean world, visit Vinpearl Aquarium Nha Trang inside VinWonders Nha Trang on Hon Tre Island. It is certainly a destination you will not want to miss on your upcoming trip to Nha Trang.

1. Remarkable Facts and Figures About Vinpearl Aquarium Nha Trang
As the first large-scale aquarium built in Vietnam, Vinpearl Aquarium Nha Trang covers up to 3,400 square meters and features a highly distinctive arched-tunnel design.
Entering the fascinating ocean world at Sea World, visitors feel as though they are walking through the deep sea while observing nearly 30,000 unusual and rare marine creatures up close. These include seven shark species listed in the Red Data Book, such as reef sharks, leopard sharks, and catsharks.
After a year-long comprehensive renovation, VinWonders Nha Trang Aquarium – Neptune’s Kingdom officially reopened on February 6, 2026, unveiling a vast, vibrant, and awe-inspiring ocean world. A major highlight is the seal pool, making its first appearance in Nha Trang and unique across the entire VinWonders system.

2. Guide to Visiting Vinpearl Aquarium Nha Trang

2.1. Vinpearl Aquarium Nha Trang Opening Hours
Visitors can explore Vinpearl Aquarium Nha Trang during the following hours:
Daily from 8:30 AM to 7:00 PM

2.2. A Detailed Aquarium Exploration Journey
Begin your journey at VinWonders Nha Trang Aquarium – Neptune’s Kingdom, where the gateway to the ocean reopened after a comprehensive year-long renovation. Step into a vivid marine world and stop at the unique seal pool, introduced in Nha Trang for the first time, to watch the playful and captivating moments of these ‘ocean performers’ in an impressive naturalistic setting. Continue through the 100-meter underwater tunnel for the sensation of traveling ‘through the sea,’ surrounded by the mesmerizing movement of marine life. The journey concludes in a magical marine kingdom containing more than 15,000 individual creatures—a colorful miniature ocean that inspires discovery. Neptune’s Kingdom is ready to take you on an entirely new ocean adventure.

2.3. Enjoy Captivating Performances
A visit to the ocean world at VinWonders Nha Trang would be incomplete without these highly engaging performances:
Mermaid Show: Watch graceful, flowing dances by mermaids in a 15-minute performance held daily from 9:30 AM to 9:45 AM.
Fish-feeding performance: Visitors can watch the skilled and professional process of caring for and feeding the fish. The 10-minute performance is held daily from 10:00 AM to 10:10 AM and from 3:00 PM to 3:10 PM.

Experience Southeast Asia’s #1 water attraction

Dive into endless splashes of excitement at the island water park that boasts the largest number of rides in Asia!

Location: Inside VinWonders Nha Trang amusement park on Hon Tre Island, Nha Trang Bay.
Highlight experiences: Conquer the Floating Bay, take on challenging and colorful slides, drift along the Lazy River, enjoy the wave pool, and more.

Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang
One destination you should not miss during a trip to Nha Trang is Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang inside VinWonders Nha Trang. With its one-of-a-kind system of thrilling slides, Lazy River, wave pool, Floating Bay, and more, the park promises complete refreshment and satisfaction.

1. Where Is Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang?
Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang address: Hon Tre Island, Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa Province
VinWonders Nha Trang operating hours: 8:30 AM–8:00 PM
Water park operating hours: Daily from 9:45 AM to 5:30 PM
Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang is frequently mentioned as one of the most popular tourist attractions in Nha Trang, the former city of Khanh Hoa Province. This Nha Trang attraction is located inside VinWonders Nha Trang amusement park on Hon Tre Island.
Panoramic view of VinWonders Nha Trang Water Park

2. Three Exciting Experiences at Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang

2.1. Conquer Seven Challenging Slides and Become an Ocean Warrior
When asked what there is to do in Nha Trang, Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang is a clear answer, with seven outstanding and challenging slides:
Level 1: Neptune’s Fury and Space Saucer duo
Level 2: Ocean Tornado
Level 3: Raging Waterspout
Level 4: Cyclone Tide
Level 5: Serpent God’s Fury
Level 6: Airstrike Fleet
Level 7: Time-Traveling Lightning
Seven exhilarating slide levels you should not miss at Nha Trang Water Park
The seven slides offer different emotional highs and are certain to provide unlimited refreshment and excitement. Among the seven levels of Vinpearl Nha Trang water park thrill rides, ‘Space Saucer’ and ‘Neptune’s Fury’ were selected by IAAPA as two of the world’s best water attractions.

2.2. Enjoy the Colorful Slides with Your Children
When visiting Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang with children, do not miss the kids’ play area and its brilliantly colorful slides, which are sure to keep them happily entertained. The children’s pool covers 900 square meters and is approximately 1 to 1.3 meters deep. This spacious area lets children play freely while remaining safe.

2.3. Conquer Vinpearl Nha Trang’s Floating Bay
A final must-have experience at Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang is playing at Vietnam’s largest floating bay. It is an excellent attraction for groups of young travelers who love challenges. Covering 4,200 square meters, the Vinpearl Nha Trang Floating Bay is designed in the shape of the word ‘Vinpearl’ and uses three primary colors: blue, green, and yellow.
The Floating Bay at Nha Trang Water Park can accommodate up to 750 people at once. Do not miss entertaining activities such as obstacle courses, slopes, elevated bridges, and action towers.

4. Tips for Visiting Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang

4.1. How to Reach Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang
VinWonders Nha Trang Water Park is located on Hon Tre Island. From central Nha Trang Ward, travel to Vinpearl Port and take the over-sea cable car to Hon Tre Island.
Most attractions on Hon Tre Island are close together, so you can walk directly to VinWonders Nha Trang without renting a vehicle. Guests staying at a Vinpearl hotel or resort on Hon Tre Island can take an electric buggy directly to the amusement park.
From the entrance of VinWonders Nha Trang, proceed to the Water World zone to visit the water park. Pass through Fairy Land and turn left to reach Water World.

4.2. Important Notes for Visiting Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang
For a thoroughly enjoyable visit to Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang, keep the following information in mind:
Prepare essential items before visiting Vinpearl Nha Trang, such as a hat, sunglasses, bath towel, face towel, swimming goggles, and sunscreen.
What should you wear to Vinpearl Nha Trang? Choose comfortable, breathable clothing so you can enjoy the attractions freely. Swimwear is mandatory when entering the pools and participating in water park activities. If you forget yours, visit an accessory shop inside the park.
To avoid the strongest sunshine, consider visiting the Nha Trang water park between 2:00 PM and 3:00 PM. You will then have about three hours to explore the park.
Some attractions impose minimum height requirements for children. Parents should pay attention to these rules and choose suitable, safe play areas for their children.
VinWonders Nha Trang Water Park is an unmissable destination for cooling off during the summer
Besides the water park, VinWonders Nha Trang has five other zones offering many exciting experiences:
Fairy Land: This zone transports you into a fairy-tale world with captivating thrill rides that are well worth trying.
Festive Hill: Designed for courageous warriors, this zone offers numerous multi-level thrill rides, including Mine Adventure and the Top Spin.
King’s Garden: Known as a miniature animal world amid the sea and sky of Hon Tre Island, this zone is home to some of the world’s rarest animals, including white Bengal tigers, American flamingos, African hippos, ring-tailed lemurs, and nearly 30 colorful bird species.
The World Garden: Admire an extraordinary botanical collection from five continents. Do not miss the Sky Wheel—one of the world’s ten largest observation wheels—for a complete view of enchanting Nha Trang Bay.
Sea World: An essential destination for anyone who wants to discover marine creatures from the vast ocean.
King’s Garden is a family-friendly zone

5. Frequently Asked Questions About Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang

5.1. Where Exactly Is Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang Located?
The water park is inside VinWonders Nha Trang amusement park on Hon Tre Island in beautiful Nha Trang Bay.

5.2. Which Highlight Water Park Experiences Should You Not Miss?
Visitors can conquer the giant Floating Bay, take on colorful and challenging slides, or relax in the modern Lazy River and wave pool areas.

5.3. How Is Water Park Admission Priced in 2026?
Water park admission is fully included in the VinWonders Nha Trang entrance ticket. You can enjoy all water attractions without purchasing a separate ticket.
Vinpearl Water Park Nha Trang is certainly a must-visit destination during the hot summer. Book your VinWonders Nha Trang tickets now and create a memorable Nha Trang travel experience!

sections.text:
Welcome Summer with the Blockbuster FLYING THEATER at VinWonders Nha Trang
VinWonders Nha Trang welcomed summer 2024 with a series of new events and entertainment formats, including the blockbuster Flying Theater. On June 1, 2023, VinWonders Nha Trang officially launched Vietnam’s first 360-degree suspended Flying Theater, taking guests across twelve of Europe’s most beautiful landscapes.

sections.heading: 1. What Is a Flying Theater?

blocks.text: A Flying Theater is a distinctive entertainment experience that uses some of the world’s most advanced technology and visual effects to create a highly realistic sensation of flight. Every sense is engaged as synchronized seat movements and on-screen imagery create an immersive illusion of flying.

Special effects and vivid sound are expertly combined to create a realistic flight experience. Seats are arranged in steep vertical tiers, allowing guests’ legs to hang freely and enhancing the unique sensation of soaring through the air.

Viewers can watch the action ahead while feeling movement below and on both sides. For added excitement, Flying Theaters may include wind that blows through your hair, drifting mist, and subtle natural fragrances throughout the space. This seamless combination makes the Flying Theater an exceptionally impressive and appealing experience that everyone should try at least once.

sections.heading: 2. Impressive Experiences at the VinWonders Nha Trang Flying Theater

blocks.text: Have you ever dreamed of soaring through the sky like a free bird? Do you long to see the world’s magnificent landscapes with your own eyes? Let VinWonders Nha Trang bring that dream to life with Vietnam’s first 360-DEGREE FLYING THEATER.
This vibrant summer, VinWonders Nha Trang will transport you across space and thousands of miles to discover twelve of Europe’s most poetic landscapes:
Begin an imaginative journey at an ancient European theater and join Harry the Rabbit as he flies across twelve natural wonders and magnificent landmarks in search of a missing magician.
Soar through the air using the world’s most advanced ‘Flying Simulation’ technology.
Feel the ‘breath’ of Europe in every scene through special effects including wind, mist, salt, water, and fragrance.
Become fully immersed in a virtual world that feels real through a panoramic curved dome screen with 4K projection and a vivid 7.1 surround-sound system.

sections.heading: 1.1. About the Stunt Show Format

blocks.text: A Stunt Show recreates thrilling action scenes from films in real life, delivering visually stunning and emotionally engaging experiences. The format originated from dangerous sequences performed by professional stunt actors on Hollywood sets. High-speed races, breathless chases, spectacular acrobatics, and large-scale battles are carefully staged to give audiences the most vivid and impressive performances possible.

sections.text:
1.1. About the Stunt Show Format

The format originated from dangerous sequences performed by professional stunt actors on Hollywood sets. Thrilling action sequences at Stunt Shows around the world (Photo: Collected)

sections.heading: 1.2. Vietnam’s First Stunt Show

blocks.text: In addition to world-leading Stunt Shows such as WaterWorld at Universal Studios and The Bourne Stuntacular at Universal Studios Orlando, visitors can now watch a Stunt Show in Vietnam. Its English title is Rise of the Ocean Princess, while its Vietnamese title is Huyen Thoai Bien Xanh.
The Stunt Show takes place at Vinpearl Harbour within the Vinpearl Nha Trang complex on poetic Hon Tre Island. It promises a fresh and distinctive visitor experience as:
Vietnam’s first live-action stunt performance
The first show to use the sea itself as its stage rather than a stage built over the water
Professionally staged and supported by systematic training from international action performers
Produced by directors and screenwriters from Universal’s renowned action-show production team.

sections.heading: 2. What Makes Stunt Show – Rise of the Ocean Princess Special?

blocks.text: If you are curious about what makes Stunt Show – Rise of the Ocean Princess so special and engaging, add it to your upcoming Nha Trang itinerary with family or friends. These are the distinctive features found only at the Nha Trang Stunt Show:

sections.text:
2. What Makes Stunt Show – Rise of the Ocean Princess Special?
If you are curious about what makes Stunt Show – Rise of the Ocean Princess so special and engaging, add it to your upcoming Nha Trang itinerary with family or friends. These are the distinctive features found only at the Nha Trang Stunt Show:

sections.heading: 2.1. A World-Leading Production Team

blocks.text: The Stunt Show’s production team—from the executive director and music producers to the action directors—includes renowned, world-leading companies:

Executive direction: Renaissance Entertainment is the world’s largest Stunt Show consultancy. It has developed concepts and provided strategic direction for major internationally award-winning shows at Universal, Disney, and Chimelong, with prominent directors such as Jon Binkowski and Lisa Enos Smith, along with many other leading experts.

Music production: The producers associated with Thomas Bergersen and Nick Phoenix’s ‘Two Steps from Hell’ are responsible for the music of Rise of the Ocean Princess in Nha Trang. The team has also earned multiple Golden Trailer Awards for music used in famous Hollywood films such as Disney’s WALL-E.

Action direction: H2O Events directly oversees the action direction for the Nha Trang Stunt Show. The company specializes in choreographing water-based action for major Stunt Shows and has repeatedly received awards as one of Australia’s leading international sports-event organizers.

Show-technology consulting: Technifex is a world-leading company with extensive experience in concept design, engineering, and the production of performance and entertainment systems. It has helped create internationally award-winning shows and attractions such as Hagrid’s Magical Creatures Motorbike Adventure, The Hebrew Bible Experience, and Volcano Bay at Universal Orlando Resort.

Show-programming consulting: Show-technology design company TechFulcrum has an extensive portfolio of notable projects and has received multiple THEA awards for A/V design, installation, and attraction control systems for Universal, Chimelong, SeaWorld, and others.

sections.heading: 2.2. A Thrilling Story and Cast of Characters

blocks.text: The story follows a poor fisherman traveling by boat with his daughter when she suddenly falls into the water. The surface begins to move, and a pearl rises from the sea containing a beautiful mermaid. The Stunt Show continues with unexpected developments and twists designed to amaze the audience.
Rise of the Ocean Princess uses exclusive characters from the VinWonders KOL universe, including:
Ocean Princess: The embodiment of the sea’s power, responsible for protecting those who earn their living at sea.
Dark Princess: The embodiment of dark power, driven by jealousy and hostility.
The Fisherman’s Daughter: The central character, rescued by the Ocean Princess and entrusted with a magical pearl.
Fire Legion: The servants of the Dark Princess.
Water Legion: A powerful squad that assists the Ocean Princess.

sections.heading: 2.3. Never-Before-Seen Spectacular Moments

blocks.text: At the Stunt Show, visitors can immerse themselves in truly one-of-a-kind moments, including:

Admire the magical movement of a giant pearl measuring 4.5 meters in diameter and positioned 14 meters below sea level, created using proprietary technology transferred from Technifex in the United States.
Enjoy floating fireworks launched from high-speed boats on the sea.
Marvel at a distinctive act combining flyboard performers, bursts of flame, and fireworks launched overhead.
Be continuously amazed by the ‘Fly by Waterjet’ stunt performance, in which fireworks shoot from the performers’ bodies like beautiful, magical butterfly wings.
Witness Vietnam’s first five-line kite performance in the sky, featuring LED lights and kite-mounted fireworks.

sections.heading: 5. How to Reach Rise of the Ocean Princess

blocks.text: Visitors can take the Vinpearl Nha Trang cable car to watch Rise of the Ocean Princess in the Monaco area of Vinpearl Harbour. This route lets you experience an advanced over-sea cable car system and admire panoramic views of Nha Trang Bay from an average height of 54 meters.
The following are the cable car ticket price and schedule for traveling to Vinpearl Harbour Nha Trang:
Ticket price: Round-trip cable car: VND 200,000 per person
Schedule: The cable car operates from 8:30 AM to 11:00 PM. From 11:00 PM to 2:00 AM, visitors travel by speedboat. The final return trip to the mainland departs at 2:15 AM.
*** Note: Cable car operating hours may change depending on operating conditions, weather, or other factors.

chunks.content:
5. How to Reach Rise of the Ocean Princess
Visitors can take the Vinpearl Nha Trang cable car to watch Rise of the Ocean Princess in the Monaco area of Vinpearl Harbour. This route lets you experience an advanced over-sea cable car system and admire panoramic views of Nha Trang Bay from an average height of 54 meters.
The following are the cable car ticket price and schedule for traveling to Vinpearl Harbour Nha Trang:
Ticket price: Round-trip cable car: VND 200,000 per person
Schedule: The cable car operates from 8:30 AM to 11:00 PM. From 11:00 PM to 2:00 AM, visitors travel by speedboat. The final return trip to the mainland departs at 2:15 AM.
*** Note: Cable car operating hours may change depending on operating conditions, weather, or other factors.
Experience Vinpearl Nha Trang’s modern, advanced cable car technology (Photo: Collected)

Enjoy a luxurious stay at Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang, relax with authentic Korean-style saunas at Aquafield, discover the thrills of VinWonders, and experience the excitement at Vinpearl Harbour!

sections.heading: Day 1: Conquer VinWonders – A Thrilling and Exciting Journey

blocks.text: Morning: Immerse Yourself in a Fairytale & Vibrant Nature
09:30 | You can check in and store your luggage at Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang to comfortably explore this exciting journey.
09:30 | Tata Welcome – Mythical Square: Let the lively melodies and legendary characters at VinWonders ignite your positive energy for an exciting day of exploration!
10:00 | World Garden – A Floral Wonderland in the Ocean: You’ll feel like stepping into a vibrant painting as you admire the stunning flowers in the heart of the island.
10:30 – 12:00 | King’s Garden – The Natural Wonder of Pearl Island: Home to intelligent birds with unique performances, this place also brings you closer to the beauty of wildlife.

sections.heading: 14:00 | Check-in & Unwind

blocks.text: You’ll check into one of the luxurious resorts, where you can indulge in a private, upscale retreat with breathtaking ocean views. Take some time to relax and recharge before diving into the excitement at VinWonders Nha Trang – an entertainment paradise filled with thrilling experiences waiting to be explored!

sections.text:
14:00 | Check-in & Unwind
You’ll check into one of the luxurious resorts, where you can indulge in a private, upscale retreat with breathtaking ocean views. Take some time to relax and recharge before diving into the excitement at VinWonders Nha Trang – an entertainment paradise filled with thrilling experiences waiting to be explored!

sections.heading: 15:00 – 16:00 | Nature Exploration at VinWonders Nha Trang

blocks.text: Begin your VinWonders adventure with a fascinating journey into the wonders of nature at King’s Garden, home to a diverse collection of exotic wildlife.

A must-see experience here is the Vibrant Bird Show , featuring dazzling performances by rare and exotic birds. Watch as colorful parrots, majestic falcons, and powerful eagles spread their wings against the sky in a mesmerizing display. Tip: Arrive 30 minutes early to grab the best seats for the show, which starts at 3:00 PM .

Next, embark on an exciting wildlife encounter as you meet the extraordinary residents of the jungle . Marvel at the regal Bengal tigers , observe the playful ring-tailed lemurs , and witness the mysterious presence of mighty rhinos . This journey brings you closer to the wonders of the wild—right in the heart of Nha Trang Bay .

Continue your exploration at Blooming Hill , a botanical paradise where nature flourishes in spectacular ways. Find serenity in the elegant Japanese Garden, immerse yourself in the romantic charm of the European floral gardens, and discover the unique Cactus Collection , showcasing resilient yet strikingly beautiful desert plants.

sections.heading: 17:00 – 18:30 | A Cutting-Edge Entertainment Journey with Advanced Technolog

blocks.text: Step into a magical world with Tata World River Adventure , Vietnam’s first indoor dark water ride . Join Princess Tata and her companions on a colorful quest to find the Gem of Happiness . With stunning light effects, an enchanting storyline, and cutting-edge technology , this immersive experience promises to be truly unforgettable.

Another must-try attraction at VinWonders Nha Trang is the 360-Degree Flying Cinema . Soar through the skies and embark on a breathtaking journey across 12 European wonders —all without leaving your seat. Thanks to state-of-the-art motion simulation , you’ll glide over snow-capped peaks, ancient castles, and spectacular landscapes , feeling every twist and turn as if you were really there!

sections.heading: Afternoon:

blocks.text: Check-in at Vinpearl Nha Trang

Arrive at Vinpearl, transfer to Hon Tre Island, and check into your accommodation. Relax in a luxurious space with a stunning sea view, breathe in the fresh air, and get ready for an exciting afternoon of exploration.
Rest and explore your own ‘home’

Take a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear pool with your family after a long journey to Vinpearl Nha Trang. Discover the services at your stay, visit the on-site restaurants, or simply check-in with some beautiful photos to mark your location with your friend list.

blocks.text: Dinner at Imperial Club
Begin your culinary journey on Hon Tre Island with delicious dishes at Imperial Club.
Tata Show & Fireworks

sections.heading: Day 2: Endless Fun at VinWonders Nha Trang and Vinpearl Harbour

blocks.text: Morning:

If you’re a sunrise enthusiast who loves fresh morning air, wake up early for a peaceful stroll along the resort’s private beach. You’ll feel the absolute tranquility and rejuvenation, setting the perfect tone for a bright new day full of exciting experiences.
Breakfast Buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant

Indulge in a luxurious breakfast buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant , where the finest Asian and European cuisines come together in a stunning beachfront setting. Savor a rich cup of coffee and a tempting plate of pastries—fueling you for a day full of energy and adventure!
Check in at VinWonders Nha Trang at 9:00 AM and take on exhilarating thrill rides for the ultimate adrenaline rush

Race through sharp turns at 12.7m/s on the Mine Adventure ride, glide around the mountain on Southeast Asia’s largest alpine coaster, or soar through the sky on Vietnam’s record-breaking Zipline, featuring the longest, steepest, and highest landing jump in the country! Note: Zipline does not include in the ticket.
Midday:
Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Princess Tata and her sisters with Tata World River Adventure , Vietnam’s first indoor dark water ride.
Next, experience cutting-edge entertainment at Vietnam’s first 360-degree floating cinema , where you’ll embark on a breathtaking journey through 12 of Europe’s most stunning landscapes .
Don’t forget to recharge with a feast at Wind &Sea Buffet , offering over 50 delectable Asian and European dishes , along with fresh local seafood.
Afternoon:

Visit King’s Garden, the unique island zoo, to meet rare animals such as Bengal tigers, ring-tailed lemurs, and camels. Immerse yourself in the vibrant beauty of hundreds of blooming flowers from around the world at The World Garden.

Stroll through the vibrant dining and shopping world of Vinpearl Harbour and enjoy a traditional Vietnamese family meal at Com Nha Linh, a restaurant that brings you back to the authentic flavors of home through rich and flavorful Vietnamese dishes.

Explore the night market, breathe in the cool evening air by the harbor, and immerse yourself in the dazzling atmosphere of the Drag Queen Show at 20:15 – a mesmerizing performance filled with color and personality.

End the night with the world’s first overwater Stunt Show at 9:15PM at Marina Square. Witness an unparalleled spectacle featuring the magical movements of a giant pearl, an extraordinary story brought to life by talented performers, breathtaking flyboard stunts, and spectacular fire and fireworks displays from above.
Day 3: Relax and Recharge for the Next Adventure

There’s no better way to restore your energy than waking up to the gentle sea breeze and starting your day with a hearty buffet breakfast at Blue Lagoon Restaurant. Next, unwind at Akoya Spa, where you can immerse yourself in a tranquil sanctuary and experience specialized spa treatments such as hot stone massage, herbal steam therapy, or natural essence skincare to rejuvenate your body and mind.

Spend your afternoon conquering Tropical Paradise , Asia’s largest water park at VinWonders Nha Trang. Challenge yourself with thrilling attractions like Neptune’s Fury & Cosmic Disc , Ocean Tornado , Fierce Dragon’s Tail , Whirlpool Tide , Serpent God’s Wrath , Aerial Fleet , and more.
Afterward, test your skills and agility at The Floating Bay , where you’ll engage in an exciting obstacle course on a giant inflatable playground in the open sea.

Don’t miss the chance to immerse yourself in the Wonder Carnival, where you can admire the mesmerizing choreography of hundreds of performers from around the world, bringing the vibrant characters of the Wonderland Kingdom to life.
Evening:

After an exciting day, it’s time for ultimate relaxation at Aquafield Nha Trang, Vietnam’s first premium Korean spa & sauna complex. Experience seven unique therapy rooms, each offering a distinct concept, with temperatures ranging from 5°C to 90°C and humidity levels between 10% and 70%, providing a diverse range of rejuvenating treatments tailored to your needs.
Day 4: Immerse Yourself in the Breathtaking Nature of Vinpearl Nha Trang Before Departure
Start your day with a lavish breakfast buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant .
Take a leisurely stroll along the bougainvillea-lined pathways , capturing your final moments on this island paradise.
Visit the serene and ancient Zen Monastery , a peaceful retreat to reflect and bring a tranquil close to your vibrant adventure.

After days of unforgettable experiences, it’s time to bid farewell to Vinpearl Nha Trang , carrying with you cherished memories. Though the journey ends, the echoes of adventure, relaxation, and pure enjoyment will stay with you forever.

page_data.full_text:
Suggested 4-Day-3-Night Travel Itinerary: Ultimate Fun & Unforgettable Experiences for Families and Friends at Vinpearl Nha Trang!

Day 1: Discovering the Services and Space of Your ‘Home’ for the Next Few Days

Afternoon:
Check-in at Vinpearl Nha Trang
Arrive at Vinpearl, transfer to Hon Tre Island, and check into your accommodation. Relax in a luxurious space with a stunning sea view, breathe in the fresh air, and get ready for an exciting afternoon of exploration.
Rest and explore your own ‘home’
Take a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear pool with your family after a long journey to Vinpearl Nha Trang. Discover the services at your stay, visit the on-site restaurants, or simply check-in with some beautiful photos to mark your location with your friend list.

Evening:
Dinner at Imperial Club
Begin your culinary journey on Hon Tre Island with delicious dishes at Imperial Club.
Tata Show & Fireworks
Indulge in a visual spectacle with the Tata Show at 7:30 PM at Luminary Square, VinWonders Nha Trang —a world-class live performance featuring cutting-edge sound, lighting, and special effects. To top it off, a dazzling fireworks display every Friday and Saturday will illuminate the night sky, marking a spectacular start to the exciting days ahead.

Day 2: Endless Fun at VinWonders Nha Trang and Vinpearl Harbour
Morning:
If you’re a sunrise enthusiast who loves fresh morning air, wake up early for a peaceful stroll along the resort’s private beach. You’ll feel the absolute tranquility and rejuvenation, setting the perfect tone for a bright new day full of exciting experiences.
Breakfast Buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant
Indulge in a luxurious breakfast buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant , where the finest Asian and European cuisines come together in a stunning beachfront setting. Savor a rich cup of coffee and a tempting plate of pastries—fueling you for a day full of energy and adventure!
Check in at VinWonders Nha Trang at 9:00 AM and take on exhilarating thrill rides for the ultimate adrenaline rush
Race through sharp turns at 12.7m/s on the Mine Adventure ride, glide around the mountain on Southeast Asia’s largest alpine coaster, or soar through the sky on Vietnam’s record-breaking Zipline, featuring the longest, steepest, and highest landing jump in the country! Note: Zipline does not include in the ticket.
Midday:
Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Princess Tata and her sisters with Tata World River Adventure , Vietnam’s first indoor dark water ride.
Next, experience cutting-edge entertainment at Vietnam’s first 360-degree floating cinema , where you’ll embark on a breathtaking journey through 12 of Europe’s most stunning landscapes .
Don’t forget to recharge with a feast at Wind &Sea Buffet , offering over 50 delectable Asian and European dishes , along with fresh local seafood.
Afternoon:
Visit King’s Garden, the unique island zoo, to meet rare animals such as Bengal tigers, ring-tailed lemurs, and camels. Immerse yourself in the vibrant beauty of hundreds of blooming flowers from around the world at The World Garden.
Stroll through the vibrant dining and shopping world of Vinpearl Harbour and enjoy a traditional Vietnamese family meal at Com Nha Linh, a restaurant that brings you back to the authentic flavors of home through rich and flavorful Vietnamese dishes.
Explore the night market, breathe in the cool evening air by the harbor, and immerse yourself in the dazzling atmosphere of the Drag Queen Show at 20:15 – a mesmerizing performance filled with color and personality.
End the night with the world’s first overwater Stunt Show at 9:15PM at Marina Square. Witness an unparalleled spectacle featuring the magical movements of a giant pearl, an extraordinary story brought to life by talented performers, breathtaking flyboard stunts, and spectacular fire and fireworks displays from above.
Day 3: Relax and Recharge for the Next Adventure
There’s no better way to restore your energy than waking up to the gentle sea breeze and starting your day with a hearty buffet breakfast at Blue Lagoon Restaurant. Next, unwind at Akoya Spa, where you can immerse yourself in a tranquil sanctuary and experience specialized spa treatments such as hot stone massage, herbal steam therapy, or natural essence skincare to rejuvenate your body and mind.
Spend your afternoon conquering Tropical Paradise , Asia’s largest water park at VinWonders Nha Trang. Challenge yourself with thrilling attractions like Neptune’s Fury & Cosmic Disc , Ocean Tornado , Fierce Dragon’s Tail , Whirlpool Tide , Serpent God’s Wrath , Aerial Fleet , and more.
Afterward, test your skills and agility at The Floating Bay , where you’ll engage in an exciting obstacle course on a giant inflatable playground in the open sea.
Don’t miss the chance to immerse yourself in the Wonder Carnival, where you can admire the mesmerizing choreography of hundreds of performers from around the world, bringing the vibrant characters of the Wonderland Kingdom to life.
Evening:
After an exciting day, it’s time for ultimate relaxation at Aquafield Nha Trang, Vietnam’s first premium Korean spa & sauna complex. Experience seven unique therapy rooms, each offering a distinct concept, with temperatures ranging from 5°C to 90°C and humidity levels between 10% and 70%, providing a diverse range of rejuvenating treatments tailored to your needs.
Day 4: Immerse Yourself in the Breathtaking Nature of Vinpearl Nha Trang Before Departure
Start your day with a lavish breakfast buffet at Blue Lagoon Restaurant .
Take a leisurely stroll along the bougainvillea-lined pathways , capturing your final moments on this island paradise.
Visit the serene and ancient Zen Monastery , a peaceful retreat to reflect and bring a tranquil close to your vibrant adventure.
After days of unforgettable experiences, it’s time to bid farewell to Vinpearl Nha Trang , carrying with you cherished memories. Though the journey ends, the echoes of adventure, relaxation, and pure enjoyment will stay with you forever.

rag_chunks.title: Feed Giraffes at The King’s Garden
